queries_run: AMD price target analyst consensus September 2026
AMD guidance raise OR cut Q3 2026

findings.claim: 55 analysts polled by S&P Global give AMD a 'Strong Buy' consensus rating with an average price target of $616.51
findings.source: S&P Global consensus data cited via ts2.tech, 'AMD Stock Jumps 8.8% to a Record as Consensus Upside Shrinks to 1%'

findings.claim: MarketBeat's consensus price target for AMD stands at $565.13, characterized as a 'Moderate Buy' rating — lower than the S&P Global figure, showing dispersion across target-price aggregators
findings.source: MarketBeat, 'Advanced Micro Devices (AMD) Stock Forecast and Price Target 2026'

findings.claim: AMD guided Q3 2026 revenue to $13.0B ± $300M (≈41% YoY growth), above the $12.52B LSEG analyst consensus estimate, but kept non-GAAP gross margin guidance flat at ~56%; stock fell despite the beat-and-raise because investors focused on the flat-margin guidance after a 20.7% run-up in the prior four sessions
findings.source: TradingKey, 'AMD Beat on Revenue, Profit, and Guidance — So Why Did the Stock Drop 7%?'

findings.claim: Some sell-side analysts have raised their 2026 revenue estimates for AMD by $2B and gross profit estimates by $1.5B, putting both materially above both Wall Street consensus and AMD's own official guidance — a divergence between the most bullish analyst models and management's stated outlook
findings.source: Simply Wall St, 'Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) Stock Forecast & Analyst Predictions'

findings.claim: In the trailing 30 days, sell-side analysts made 33 upward FY2027 EPS revisions against only 3 downward revisions, and consensus fair value/price target estimates rose (e.g., one model's fair value from $213.89 to $225.00, consensus price target from $291 to $312 in an earlier framework), reflecting broad-based upward revision momentum tied to AI/data-center demand and recent large GPU deals (Meta, OpenAI)
findings.source: Simply Wall St, 'Advanced Micro Devices (NasdaqGS:AMD) Stock Forecast & Analyst Predictions'

capital_markets_pricing.note: 目標價在不同聚合站落差大（S&P Global $616.51 vs MarketBeat $565.13，皆為 2026-09 中旬資料），未查到單一權威 as-of 分布中位數/區間統計，僅列來源各自數字。現價比較留給判斷層引 numbers.price_at_dd。
